Demo biotech for LLM Screening. Pre-PCC small molecule platform.
Demo biotech for LLM Screening. Mid-stage respiratory antibody.

Strong fit on every dimension: immunology IO BsAb, close-to-IND with full preclinical package, Chinese biotech with a clinically validated platform asset, Global + China rights on offer. Recommend advancing to scientific deep-dive.

Asset overview (Hangzhou ImmunoBio): - Program: HIB-201, a CD3xCLDN18.2 bispecific antibody for gastric cancer (immuno-oncology). - Modality: IgG-like bispecific antibody. Molecule sequence finalized, expressible at 2.1 g/L, no developability flags. - Stage: Close to IND. GLP tox study scheduled Q3; IND filing targeted within 6 months. - Preclinical data: Mouse efficacy in MC38-hCLDN18.2 tumor model (TGI 78%); cyno PK with t1/2 ~9 days; cyno repeat-dose tox NOAEL established. - Platform: Internal CD3-engaging bispecific platform; previously generated HIB-101 (anti-CD20xCD3) which is currently in Phase 1 in China (clinically validated). - Company: Chinese biotech, Hangzhou-based, Series B. - Deal: Global rights + China rights (clinical & commercial) on offer.

Pass overall blocked by two required failures: small molecule modality without IND-stage differentiation, and pre-PCC stage without a clinically validated platform asset. Recommend decline at this time; revisit if a candidate reaches IND with strong differentiation.

Asset overview (Shanghai SmallMol Tx): - Program: SMT-014, oral small-molecule TYK2 allosteric inhibitor for psoriasis. - Modality: Small molecule; lead series identified, hit-to-lead complete, lead optimization ongoing. - Stage: Pre-PCC; current lead has acceptable potency (IC50 ~12 nM) but selectivity vs JAK1/2/3 still being optimized. - Preclinical data: Mouse IMQ-induced psoriasis model shows dose-dependent reduction in PASI; PK in rodents established; monkey PK not yet generated. - Platform: Allosteric kinase inhibitor platform; no clinically validated asset to date; earliest program at pre-PCC stage. - Company: Chinese biotech, Shanghai-based, Series A. - Deal: Global + China rights available.

Asset clears all hard gates (TA, modality, stage, China rights) but Phase 2 readout disclosed only top-line efficacy without a dose-response plot; flagging needs_info on PoC/dose-response. Recommend requesting per-dose efficacy and PK/PD data before team review.

Asset overview (Suzhou RespiraBio): - Program: SRB-220, anti-TSLP monoclonal antibody for severe asthma. - Modality: Humanized IgG4 monoclonal antibody. - Stage: Phase 2b ongoing in China (n=240, three dose arms 50/150/300 mg q4w); Phase 2a primary endpoint (annualized asthma exacerbation rate at week 24) met with p<0.01 vs placebo. - Clinical data disclosed: Top-line Phase 2a readout shared (overall reduction in AAER, safety summary). Per-dose efficacy breakdown and PK/PD modelling not in current deck. - Deal: Greater China rights mandatory; partial Global rights (ex-US/EU) negotiable. US/EU rights retained by company. - Company: Chinese biotech, Suzhou-based, Series C.
